description: Deployment history with status dots, commit messages, branches, and durations.

files.content:
import { GitBranch as GitBranchIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const deployments = [ { id: "dpl_8f2a", status: "Ready", commit: "Fix /templates grid on mobile", branch: "main", duration: "48s", ago: "5m", }, { id: "dpl_7c1d", status: "Building", commit: "Add 120 new icons", branch: "feat/icons", duration: "—", ago: "1m", }, { id: "dpl_6b90", status: "Error", commit: "Upgrade image pipeline", branch: "chore/deps", duration: "1m 12s", ago: "2h", }, { id: "dpl_5a44", status: "Ready", commit: "Copy tweaks on pricing page", branch: "main", duration: "41s", ago: "1d", }, ] const dot: Record = { Ready: "bg-primary", Building: "bg-primary animate-pulse", Error: "bg-destructive", } export default function DeploymentsTable() { return (
Status Commit Duration Age {deployments.map((d) => ( {d.status}

{d.commit}

{d.branch}

{d.duration} {d.ago} ))}
) }
